test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What monumental site in India houses Magan Niwas, Hriday Kunj and Vinoba-Mira Kutir?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sabarmati Ashram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sabarmati Ashram** is located in **Ahmedabad, Gujarat**.
 
• It was one of the residences of **Mahatma Gandhi**, who lived there for about twelve years.
 
• The ashram is historically significant as it was from here that Gandhi led the **Dandi March** in 1930.
 
• **Magan Niwas**, **Hriday Kunj**, and **Vinoba-Mira Kutir** are key structures within the Sabarmati Ashram.
 
• **Hriday Kunj** was the personal quarters of **Mahatma Gandhi** and his wife, Kasturba Gandhi.
 
• **Magan Niwas** was named after **Maganlal Gandhi**, a close associate of Mahatma Gandhi.
 
• **Vinoba-Mira Kutir** was the residence of **Vinoba Bhave** and **Madeleine Slade** (Mira Ben), both ardent followers of Gandhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ramchandra Mission**__

 __
 
• **Ramchandra Mission** is a spiritual organization founded by **Ram Chandra** (Lalaji Maharaj) of Shahjahanpur, UP.
 
• It focuses on **meditation and spiritual training**.
 
• It is also known as the **Shri Ram Chandra Mission (SRCM)**.
 
 
 
• **Auroville**__
 __
 
• **Auroville** is an experimental township in **Viluppuram district** in Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• It was founded in 1968 by **The Mother** (Mirra Alfassa) of the **Sri Aurobindo Society**.
 
• Auroville was designed to be a **universal town** where people from all countries could live in peace and progressive harmony.
 
 
 
• **Vinoba Ashram**__
 
 
• **Vinoba Ashram** is named after **Vinoba Bhave**, a prominent Indian advocate of nonviolence and human rights.
 
• It focuses on **rural development** and **self-sufficiency**.
